title: Voice Group Switch
description: Browse and switch Simple Voice Chat groups without leaving your current group first.
body:
# Voice Group Switch

**Simple Voice Chat Addon!**
Client-Side Mod

Voice Group Switch improves the Simple Voice Chat group experience by letting you browse available voice groups while staying in your current one. You can switch groups directly from the browse list, join locked groups with a password, and avoid accidentally leaving your current group until the new join actually succeeds.

It is built for players who use Simple Voice Chat groups often and want faster, smoother group switching without extra menu hopping.

![GroupList](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f84f8b4148718f3b0009ae708cae940dd3b0c028.png)

## Dependencies

- Simple Voice Chat

Made by Articuling
